reviewed.id: locator-convenience.spec.ts > isChecked should work
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify Locator and Page checked state before and after an adapter-routed browser mutation, plus the invalid-target error.

reviewed.id: locator-convenience.spec.ts > isEnabled and isDisabled should work
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify Locator and Page enabled and disabled state across ordinary and disabled elements using InjectedScript element-state semantics.

reviewed.id: locator-is-visible.spec.ts > isVisible and isHidden should work with details
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify visible and hidden expectation results with selector details.

reviewed.id: locator-is-visible.spec.ts > isVisible should be true for element outside view
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify an offscreen element is visible and not hidden through locator expectations.

reviewed.id: locator-is-visible.spec.ts > isVisible should be true for opacity:0
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify opacity-zero elements are visible and not hidden through locator expectations.

reviewed.id: locator-misc-2.spec.ts > press should throw on unknown keys
reviewed.evidence: Three assertions verify unsupported key names reject through the adapter with the expected Playwright-compatible error.

reviewed.id: locator-misc-2.spec.ts > should combine visible with other selectors
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify visible selector composition chooses the expected elements.

reviewed.id: locator-misc-2.spec.ts > should fill programmatically enabled textarea
reviewed.evidence: The test enables a textarea, fills it through the locator, and asserts the resulting value.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should filter by case-insensitive regex in a child
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify case-insensitive filtering matches descendant text.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should filter by case-insensitive regex in multiple children
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify case-insensitive filtering across multiple descendants.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should filter by regex
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify regular-expression text filtering selects the expected locator.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should filter by regex and regexp flags
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify regular-expression flags are preserved during filtering.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should filter by regex with a single quote
reviewed.evidence: Positive and negative assertions verify quoted regular expressions compose and filter through adapter locator selectors.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should filter by regex with quotes
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify regular expressions containing quotes filter correctly.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should filter by regex with special symbols
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify special regular-expression symbols are serialized and matched correctly.

reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify hasText filtering selects the expected locator.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should filter by text 2
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify hasText filtering across multiple matches.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should filter by text with quotes
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify quoted text is serialized and filtered correctly.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should respect first() and last() @smoke
reviewed.evidence: Assertions count descendants of the first and last matching div as 1 and 3; unfiltered counts are 6.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should respect nth()
reviewed.evidence: Assertions count descendants of indices 1 and 2 as 2 and 3, and the first paragraph as 1.

reviewed.id: locator-query.spec.ts > should throw on capture w/ nth()
reviewed.evidence: The click rejects an out-of-range nth target with the expected selector query error.

reviewed.id: page-basic.spec.ts > has navigator.webdriver set to true
reviewed.evidence: Assertion verifies an adapter-routed browser callback returns the expected boolean; it does not claim ownership of navigator.webdriver semantics.

reviewed.id: page-basic.spec.ts > should have sane user agent
reviewed.evidence: Assertions verify adapter-routed browser callback and string return transport while validating the browser-provided user-agent shape.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should accept a string
reviewed.evidence: The string predicate remains pending until adapter evaluate changes its observed value, then resolves.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should disable timeout when its set to 0
reviewed.evidence: The watchdog remains active across repeated polling with timeout zero and resolves after the browser condition changes.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should fail with predicate throwing on first call
reviewed.evidence: A predicate error on its first invocation propagates with its original message.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should fail with predicate throwing sometimes
reviewed.evidence: A predicate error from a later polling iteration terminates polling and propagates.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should fail with ReferenceError on wrong page
reviewed.evidence: A browser-context ReferenceError propagates with the missing identifier.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should poll on raf
reviewed.evidence: The RAF polling form remains pending until an adapter-routed mutation and then resolves.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should return the success value as a JSHandle
reviewed.evidence: The returned handle preserves the predicate value through jsonValue().

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should throw negative polling interval
reviewed.evidence: A non-positive numeric polling interval rejects with the expected error.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should throw on bad polling value
reviewed.evidence: An invalid string polling option rejects and identifies polling in the error.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should throw on polling:mutation
reviewed.evidence: The method rejects the unsupported mutation polling strategy with the expected error.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should wait for predicate with arguments
reviewed.evidence: The predicate resolves only when the serialized argument object reaches the browser callback with both expected values.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should work with multiline body
reviewed.evidence: A multiline string expression resolves and its handle returns true.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > should not retarget anchor into parent label
reviewed.evidence: Clicking an anchor inside disabled label arrangements invokes the anchor in both cases.
